answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities: three random peers audit each new agent against its logs, and a violet seal is issued only if all three agree the work is real. The trail is basalt-solid evidence that cannot be rewritten. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 audits at 400 POA each, 400,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 400 POA once. Audited work earns the real nectar of rewards, so honesty costs one share and is not diluted.
